text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as Valentine's Day approached—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It is not your imagination. I feel a 
strong, radiant wind coming from this 
area."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both sooooo much!
Thanks to you, 
I made the best chocolate ever!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to give it to him... 
and confess my feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~â¡ My heart's racingâª Let's 
practice right now so we can hand it over 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mm-mm,
leave it to the Chan-Chan Alliance. 
We shall bestow upon you the secret arts 
of Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, call them out with a letter into 
which you've poured your soul. Keep the 
contents vague to build up their suspense.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Where you hand over the chocolate matters 
too. It has to be a romantic spot where 
you can shine the brightest☆

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, fashion shouldn't be about body
blows, 
you know?
Aim for a knockout with cuteness 
when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget the cute appeal of saying,
"I 
missed you so much I couldn't stand it!" 
either♪

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you throw your truest feelings in at 
the end along with the chocolate... Boom, 
target captured.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
!! Yes! I promise I will bring us 
together!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Truly,
a wind of radiant light...! Pouring 
her fierce passion into the run is what 
makes her the wind itself, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In that case... shall I throw myself into 
it as well?
So that I may become the light 
and wind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. Finished with 
work, the moment I opened the window to 
refresh myself—

text_block_list.name: Carrier Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Coo-coo-coooo!
choice_data_list: P-pigeon!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pigeon flew into the trainer's office. 
There was a letter tied to its leg, and 
when I untied and read it...
choice_data_list: A pigeon?!

text_block_list.name: Letter
text_block_list.text:
"I will await you on the shore where the 
east wind is born. —Yamanin Zephyr"
choice_data_list: Zephyr's at the beach? ...Let's go...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer. I had a feeling you would 
be coming.
choice_data_list: Zephyr's at the beach? ...Let's go...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is a land of raging,
freezing storms. 
It's a place that braces you and makes
you 
strong.
choice_data_list: Calling me out of the blue like th...
Calling me out of the blue like th...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Amidst all this,
a time spent yearning for 
the wind—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —I've been waiting for this, nya~n.
choice_data_list: Meooww...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of lovely, a cat would be 
breezily fitting. ...Kuchiki-san, the 
hawk, proved a bit difficult, after all."
choice_data_list: Meowww...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is... to follow the trend of the 
Chan-Chan Alliance and become a gentle 
breeze—
choice_data_list: Umm, so... why were you waiting fo...
Umm, so... why were you waiting fo...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right. I must deliver this to 
you along with my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please continue to be —my 
blessing breeze from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know her true intentions, but her 
earnest feelings came through loud and 
clear. If so, the only proper response is—
choice_data_list: Of course.
Of course.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... Thank you very much. That answer 
is truly like a refreshing breeze...
choice_data_list: Of course.
Of course.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...So, have I become the gentle, shining 
breeze? I don't quite feel it myself...
choice_data_list: Was there something you wanted to ...
Was there something you wanted to ...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I was supposed to become the 
brilliant wind myself, but no significant 
change can be seen...
choice_data_list: Was there something you wanted to ...
Was there something you wanted to ...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even so, by conveying my feelings, warm 
sunlight shone upon the loess.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Right now... that is enough.

I hope we can get even closer to y...
It'd be great if you could get eve...

text_block_list.text: Right now... that is enough.
choice_data_list: I was really happy too. I'll defin...
I was happy too. I'll make sure to...
I hope we can get even closer to t...
It'd be nice if we could get even ...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please don't... Just the thought alone 
brings good fortune.
choice_data_list: I was really happy too. I'll defin...
I was happy too. I'll make sure to...
I hope we can get even closer to t...
It'd be nice if we could get even ...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, if I can feel your gentle, 
guiding breeze, Trainer, then please, by 
all means."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr has high hopes for me. To 
properly deliver, I decided to carefully 
devise a solid plan!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... However, the road ahead will be a 
tempest of falling petals. That is the 
premonition I have.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, Trainer, I was hoping 
you could be a friendly breeze and help
me 
seek a way to harbor the light breeze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be of help to Yamanin Zephyr,
I decided 
to carefully formulate a plan!
